SBS (banking software company) is a French banking software company headquartered in Paris. It develops software for core banking, digital banking, payments, and retail.
The company operates in Europe, Africa, the United Kingdom, North America and the Asia–Pacific region.
History
Sopra Banking Software was established in 2012 based on the banking software assets of the Sopra Steria Group.
During the 2010s, the company expanded its product portfolio and international presence through a series of acquisitions of software providers in Europe.
In September 2024, Sopra Banking Software was acquired by French-American publicly held information technology company Axway in a transaction valued at €330 million. Following the acquisition, Sopra Banking Software became part of the Axway Group as a separate business unit. Axway CEO Patrick Donovan became the head of the combined entity, while Sopra Banking Software CEO Eric Bierry assumed the role of deputy CEO.
In October 2024, Sopra Banking Software was rebranded as SBS.

Operations
In 2025, SBS reported revenue of €371.2 million. Annual recurring revenue (ARR) reached €243.8 million at the end of 2025.
In 2024, product revenue amounted to €251.7 million, with services revenue of €110.2 million.
Industry recognition
SBS was included in The Forrester Wave: Digital Banking Processing Platforms, Q4 2024, where it was categorised among market contenders. The company was also profiled in Celent's Retail Digital Banking Platforms: Europe, Middle East, Africa Edition (2025).
